Our story

How we began.

It all began in the most ordinary place—the office, where two people crossed paths without knowing that their simple meeting would become the start of something beautiful. As time passed, conversations turned into friendship, and friendship slowly blossomed into love.

Our greatest blessing came when our daughter entered the world. She gave our love a deeper meaning, filled our days with joy and laughter, and transformed our story from one of two people into a family built on love.

From an unexpected meeting at work to a life filled with love, memories, and dreams, our journey has brought us to this beautiful moment. And now, we are ready to begin our next chapter—together, forever.

With love

A Little Something for Our Next Chapter

Having you with us as we begin this next chapter is more than enough, and your presence will always be the gift we treasure most.

If you wish to give something beyond your presence, a monetary gift toward our future together would be sincerely appreciated as we build our home and life as a family.

For your convenience, a gift envelope will also be available at the venue. You may also send your gift securely through InstaPay using the QR code below.

A kindly note

Two things to know before you RSVP.

Adults-only celebration No additional plus-ones

Can I bring a plus-one?

We kindly ask that you attend with the guest named on your invitation. Due to our limited venue capacity, we’re keeping our celebration intimate and are unable to accommodate additional plus-ones. We truly appreciate your understanding and hope you’ll still celebrate this special day with us.

Are children welcome?

We adore your little ones, but as our program will run late into the evening, we’ve chosen to keep our celebration adults-only so the children can rest comfortably at home. We hope you understand, and we truly appreciate your support as we celebrate this special milestone.

RSVP

Will you join us?

Kindly respond by the first of November, 2026. One note per guest or family is perfect.

Thank you

Details

Good to know.

Getting there & parking

The ceremony will be at St. John the Baptist in Taytay, followed by the reception at Villa Ardin in Cainta. The venues are about 15 minutes apart. Free parking is available at both. Please allow extra time for traffic.

Cocktail hour

After the ceremony, enjoy some food and drinks while we take a few photos. Each guest will receive a food stub for the cocktail hour.

Photography & phones

Feel free to take photos and videos throughout the celebration. During the ceremony, we kindly ask that phones and cameras be kept away so everyone can be fully present and our photographers can capture the moments beautifully.

Snap & Share

Capture the moments and share them with us! 📸 We’d love to see the celebration through your eyes.
